errors.egress_scheme_apprise: Apprise URL {{line}}: Meshloom does not send to this kind of Apprise URL ({{scheme}}://). Supported: ntfy, Telegram, Discord, Gotify, Home Assistant, Matrix, e-mail (mailto), MQTT, Signal, Slack, Pushover, JSON/XML/form webhooks and a few others listed in the docs. Desktop, local and cloud-credential services are refused.
errors.egress_private_address_apprise: Apprise URL {{line}}: this address is on a private network (LAN, this machine) or is a cloud metadata address. Allow private networks for this integration if it is yours; metadata addresses are always refused.
errors.egress_unresolvable_apprise: Apprise URL {{line}}: the host name was not found. Check it, or type the IP address instead.
errors.apprise_url_invalid: Apprise URL {{line}}: Apprise does not understand this URL. Check it against the Apprise wiki.
errors.apprise_chat_id_required: Apprise URL {{line}}: a Telegram URL needs a chat id (tgram://bot_token/chat_id).

privateNetwork.label: Allow a destination on a private network (LAN, localhost)
privateNetwork.help: Off by default: Meshloom refuses a destination on your local network or on this machine, so a changed setting cannot turn the server into a probe of your network. Turn it on for Home Assistant, Gotify, ntfy, Node-RED or a script on your LAN. Cloud metadata addresses are always refused.
privateNetwork.grandfathered: These integrations were set up before Meshloom checked destinations, so private network addresses stay allowed for them and they keep working: {{names}}. Untick "Allow a destination on a private network" in an integration if it points to a public service.
